cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The raw_html method directly returns user-provided HTML content without neutralization when skip_html option is false, allowing injection of special elements that modify downstream HTML parsing

connection.evidence: User-provided HTML from Markdown input flows directly through the html parameter to the return statement, with demonstrated path: parse_block_html → raw_html → final HTML output

diff_causality.evidence: The method signature change adds 'self' parameter but doesn't materially alter the injection mechanism; the vulnerable behavior existed before this change

security_control.evidence: The skip_html option provides conditional escaping, but when disabled, no neutralization occurs for HTML special elements
security_control.required_control: HTML encoding/escaping for user-provided raw HTML content
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-74 requires neutralization of special elements in output; raw HTML containing script tags, event handlers, or other HTML special elements can modify downstream parsing
existing_controls_checked: conditional escape() call when skip_html is true
no validation when skip_html is false
security_control.deficiency_evidence: When skip_html option is false (default unknown), the method returns raw HTML without any encoding, allowing injection of arbitrary HTML/JavaScript

concrete_impact.evidence: Cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks are possible if the rendered HTML is served to web clients without additional output encoding

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the method would still exist with the same injection vulnerability; the self parameter addition doesn't change the security behavior.
supporting_evidence: Method returns html parameter directly when skip_html option is false
html parameter originates from user-provided Markdown input containing raw HTML
No validation or sanitization applied to raw HTML content in default case
Returned HTML is incorporated into final rendered output
contradicting_evidence: The change is a method signature modification (adding self parameter) rather than introducing new vulnerable functionality
unresolved_facts: Default value of skip_html option is unknown
Whether downstream contexts apply additional output encoding
Specific deployment context and security requirements
review_comment: The raw_html method returns user-provided HTML content without encoding when the skip_html option is disabled, creating an HTML injection vulnerability. While this change only adds a self parameter, the underlying vulnerability allows injection of arbitrary HTML/JavaScript into the rendered output. Ensure the skip_html option defaults to true or implement mandatory HTML sanitization before returning user content.
